info.description: Tokens come from the local Keycloak realm. FHIR calls go to the dev server at /fhir/{guid}/r4. Run the Tokens folder first. Set tenantGuid to the guid in issuer-registry.local.json.

item.name: 2. Authorizer denials
item.description: These fail before a FHIR store call. Status 401 is an invalid token class. Status 403 is insufficient_scope.

request.description: No Authorization header.
The header is present and is not a JWT.
The token is valid and the guid is not in allowed_tenant_guids.
user/ scopes are dropped. Nothing remains to grant.

item.name: patient claim is not a FHIR id

request.description: The patient attribute is "bad id", which cannot be a launch patient.

item.name: 3. System scopes
item.description: Allowed calls can still be 404 or 500 when the tenant store has no matching resource. A 401 or a scope 403 fails the test. The sample tenant allowlist is Patient, Observation, and Parameters.

request.description: The ceiling grants Observation read and search only.

item.name: Encounter is outside the sample allowlist

request.description: type_not_allowed when the tenant allowlist omits Encounter. insufficient_scope when the allowlist is * because the ceiling has no Encounter grant.
system/Patient.read intersects the ceiling to system/Patient.rs.
system/*.read narrows to Patient.rs and Observation.rs.

item.name: system read remains after a user scope is dropped

request.description: user/Patient.rs is dropped. system/Patient.rs remains.

item.name: another Patient id is not found

request.description: The foreign id is not echoed in the body.

item.name: patient scope cannot create a Patient
observation search stays in the compartment

request.description: The handler adds subject=Patient/patient-200.

item.name: observation read outside the compartment is not found
create Observation for the launch patient
patient create rejects a client id
JSON Patch on an unknown observation is not found

request.description: Membership is checked before the patch body. An unknown id is 404 and nothing is patched. An in-compartment JSON Patch is 403 because the patch cannot be checked against the launch patient.

item.name: user scope is honored when the issuer opts in

request.description: Realm fhir-user maps to a registry entry with allow_user_scopes true. user/Patient.rs acts as tenant-wide Patient read and search.

item.name: user scope is denied when the issuer does not opt in

request.description: Realm fhir has allow_user_scopes false. The same user/Patient.rs request is dropped and nothing remains.

item.name: granular search is narrowed to the grant

request.description: The handler appends category=vital-signs beside the compartment subject.

item.name: granular search ANDs a conflicting client param

request.description: The grant constraint is appended, not replaced, so a laboratory request cannot widen it. Any entry returned would be a violation.

item.name: granular read outside the grant is not found

request.description: A stored Observation that fails the constraint reads as missing. Without seeded data this proves the 404 shape, not the mismatch branch.

item.name: granular write outside the grant is forbidden

request.description: status preliminary is outside patient/Observation.cu?status=final. The subject is the launch patient, so only the constraint refuses it.
A JSON Patch has no body to check against the constraint, so a constrained update grant refuses it.
